name: Black Bean Sweet Potato Tacos
description: Vegetarian tacos with roasted sweet potato, black beans, cumin, and chili powder.

instructions.text: Set out a baking sheet, mixing bowl, small saucepan, knife, and spatula. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the center.
Scrub and peel 1 large sweet potato. Cut it lengthwise into slices about 1/2 inch thick, cut the slices into strips, then into 1/2-inch cubes. Keep the pieces similar in size so they cook evenly.
Put the cubes in the bowl with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon cumin, and 1 teaspoon chili powder. Stir until coated. Spread on the baking sheet in a single layer with space between the pieces.

Roast for 20–30 minutes, turning the cubes with a spatula after 15 minutes. They are ready when the edges are lightly browned and a fork slides easily through the center. If firm, roast another 5 minutes and check again.

While the potato roasts, open one 15-ounce can black beans, drain in a sieve, and rinse. Put the beans in the saucepan with 2 tablespoons water. Heat over medium-low heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until steaming throughout. Add another tablespoon water if they begin to stick, then turn off the heat.
Warm 6 tortillas in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 20–30 seconds per side until pliable. Stack them on a plate and cover with a clean towel to keep warm.
Divide the beans and roasted sweet potato among the 6 tortillas. Serve 2 tacos per person, for 3 servings, while the filling is warm.

source.originalInstructions: Roast diced sweet potato with olive oil, cumin, and chili powder. Warm black beans and tortillas, then assemble tacos.
